Histeon: some versions cannot be read.
Il loro contenuto non corrisponde più al: Their content no longer matches their fingerprint, and pages may look empty in the builder. It usually happens when the site moves to another address (All-in-One WP Migration, Duplicator, search-replace): the address changes inside the versions too. Enter the address the site had before the move: Histeon repairs only the versions that differ by that address alone, without changing their content.
Ho controllato le pagine: accetto le ver: I have checked the pages: I accept the remaining versions as they are now.
Se lo spostamento ha portato tutti gli i: If the move turned every address into https, Histeon cannot prove that only the address changed. In that case, after the repair, you can accept the remaining versions: this is recorded in the Histeon log.
Solo un amministratore ripara le version: Only an administrator can repair the versions.
Per accettare le versioni rimaste serve: Accepting the remaining versions needs your confirmation.
L'indirizzo di prima non è valido: scriv: The previous address is not valid: write it in full, for example http://site.local.
